    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage
      • 4 Swiss Rounds
      • All matches are Bo3
      • Top 4 advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs
      • Singe Eliminiation Bracket
      • All matches are Bo5
    • 3 Swiss or Liechtenstein player need to be playing for each team at all times
      • If a team is part of a Swiss organisation, the limit is lowered to 2 Swiss or Liechtenstein player
